results.name: Norstella Launches Atlas, an Agentic AI Platform Built on Biopharma's Most Connected Data | Norstella
results.content:
*New platform combines Norstella’s proprietary data assets with purpose-built AI agents to deliver decision-ready outputs across the drug development lifecycle*  
**New York – August 4, 2026**: [Norstella](https://www.norstella.com/), the connected data foundation the life sciences industry relies on, today launched [Norstella Atlas](https://ai.norstella.com/), an agentic AI platform that turns that foundation into finished, decision-ready work.  
For decades, Norstella has been ingesting, curating, linking, tokenizing, and refining trillions of disparate data points to surface the insights that matter most across the drug development lifecycle. Atlas is the layer that turns this data into finished work: competitive landscapes, feasibility assessments, launch plans, and access strategies. These are decisions where a confident answer isn’t the same as a correct one.  
Built on proprietary clinical, commercial, market access and real-world data from Norstella brands, [Citeline](https://www.citeline.com/), [Evaluate](https://www.evaluate.com/), [MMIT](https://www.mmitnetwork.com/) and [Panalgo](https://panalgo.com/), Atlas works across the industry’s most interconnected and trusted data that helps teams move from question to answer faster. This data network has been built over three decades, with individual trials, drugs, companies, payers, plans, and events all linked to one another. No model trained on public data can replicate it.
Every Atlas agent will be persona-specific, and agents planned for delivery will address business development and licensing, feasibility, portfolio strategy and protocol design. A shared platform architecture provides common standards for security, sourcing, governance, and transparency. And by combining Norstella’s proprietary data, with a customer’s own internal intelligence, the output reflects both the wider market and the organization’s context.  
Dozens of agents and AI-enabled solutions, including Citeline’s SmartSolutions, Evaluate’s Ella and Omnium, MMIT’s Mosaic and Searchlight, and NorstellaLinQ, are already at work inside Norstella, powering Atlas, accelerating product development, and supporting the ongoing curation of the data.  
Norstella’s vision for Atlas extends beyond automation. By combining human expertise with trusted proprietary data and AI-powered workflows, Atlas keeps people in the loop, helping organizations move faster and with greater confidence.  
For more information about Norstella Atlas, visit [ai.norstella.com](https://ai.norstella.com/).  
**About Norstella**
**About Norstella**  
Norstella is the AI company for biopharma’s highest-stakes decisions. A global life sciences company trusted by every Top 100 pharma company and industry experts the world over, Norstella unites market-leading brands — [Citeline](https://www.citeline.com/), [Evaluate](https://www.evaluate.com/), [MMIT](https://www.mmitnetwork.com/), [Panalgo](https://panalgo.com/), [Skipta](https://www.skipta.com/), and [The Dedham Group](https://dedhamgroup.com/) — turning decision-grade data, insights and expertise into AI you can act on. With the patient always at the center, Norstella is advancing the path to life-changing therapies for patients and providers. Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/norstellacompany) for real-time updates.  
For media inquiries, please contact:
[norstella@diffusionpr.com](https://www.norstella.com/press-releases/launches-atlas-agentic-ai-platform-built-biopharmas-most-connected-data/mailto:norstella@diffusionpr.com)
